plan.notes: Source: official WVU 2026-2027 Undergraduate Catalog page for Computer Science, B.S.C.S., Lane Department of Computer Science and Electrical Engineering, Benjamin M. Statler College of Engineering and Mineral Resources (Morgantown). Source URL: http://catalog.wvu.edu/undergraduate/collegeofengineeringandmineralresources/lanedepartmentofcomputerscienceand/computer_science/ Transcription method: manual transcription of the catalog's own 'Suggested Plan of Study' term-by-term table (Fall/Spring Years 1-4, 122 total credit hours), cross-checked against the catalog's Curriculum Requirements tables for titles, hours, and elective rules. Labs (CS 110L/111L/210L/330L, CPE 271L) are folded into their parent lecture courses exactly as the catalog's plan lists them as single combined entries (e.g. 'CS 110 & 110L', 4 credits). Choice slots use placeholder codes (GEF/ITE/etc.) with choice_note recording the catalog's selection rules; Discrete Mathematics Requirement slots follow the catalog's Option A / Option B pair structure. CSEE 480S/481S are the catalog plan's listed capstone sequence (catalog notes CSEE 480/481 as alternates). prereq arrays are left empty because the catalog's suggested plan does not enumerate per-course prerequisites (it only instructs students to observe all prerequisites and concurrent requirements) — inventing prereqs would violate the no-invention rule. Degree requires minimum 122 credit hours, C- or better in listed CS/math/science and Fundamentals of Engineering courses, and 2.00 Overall/WVU/Statler GPAs per the catalog's Degree Requirements.
